evidence: Touches the internal HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp and carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
rationale: Mitigates HTTP connection slot exhaustion caused by clients trickling bytes without ever completing a request. While this prevents unauthenticated Slowloris-style connection denial, the author notes the practical impact is low because RPC binds to localhost by default, making the fix worthwhile but deferrable.
